notice: Governed precious-metal pricing snapshot (SEO-A4.4). Separate from data/rate_snapshot.json. No quote may be stored unless its source's license_state permits publication; derived values (cross, inverse, ratio) are computed at build time and never stored.

sources.name: LBMA Gold Price and LBMA Silver Price
sources.license_basis: Benchmark use for valuation and pricing requires a usage licence from IBA; ConvertCCY holds none.

license_evidence.supports: Any party using the LBMA Gold Price for valuation and pricing activities and in transactions and financial products requires a usage licence with IBA

sources.name: LBMA Precious Metals Prices (benchmark settings)
sources.license_basis: Benchmark settings are available under licence from IBA, including for valuation and pricing; ConvertCCY holds none.

license_evidence.supports: These LBMA Precious Metals Prices benchmark settings are available under licence from IBA (including for valuation and pricing activities and for use in transactions)

sources.name: LBMA Platinum Price and LBMA Palladium Price
sources.license_basis: Listed among LBMA Precious Metal Prices; the administrator's redistribution terms could not be retrieved (automated access refused), so rights are unclear.

license_evidence.supports: LBMA Precious Metal Prices: International prices for gold, silver, platinum and palladium

sources.name: London Platinum and Palladium Market (LPPM)
sources.license_basis: Market body for Good Delivery standards; its public site states no redistribution terms for price data.

sources.name: exchangerate-api.com (current ConvertCCY FX provider)
sources.license_basis: Publishes no XAU, XAG, XPT or XPD values (absent from data/rate_snapshot.json); usable only as the FX leg of a future derived value.

freshness_policy.reference_clock: captured_at of this snapshot (deterministic builds; never the wall clock)
freshness_policy.stale_behaviour: no numeric value rendered; the state and source date are shown

derivation_policy.cross: metal quote x (target FX rate / quote-currency FX rate); both sources and timestamps shown
derivation_policy.inverse: 1 / metal value in that currency, labelled derived_inverse
derivation_policy.ratio: metal A value / metal B value; same quote currency, same unit, within max skew
derivation_policy.refuse_when: licence not publishable, stale, missing timestamp, unit mismatch, or skew above the limit

precision_policy.direct: exactly the decimal places published by the source; no added digits
precision_policy.derived: significant digits = clamp(floor(-log10(sum of relative input uncertainties)), 3, 6); uncertainty is half a unit of each input's last published digit (A3 rule)
precision_policy.ratio: as derived; both metal legs contribute uncertainty
